# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)
# Provides a stable, modern OS environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package installations to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, dependencies, MPI, and certificates
# - build-essential: Compiler suite (gcc, g++, make)
# - cmake: Build system generator for LAMMPS
# - git: For cloning the source code
# - ca-certificates: For secure network connections (e.g., git clone)
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: OpenMPI runtime and development libraries for containerized MPI
# - libgomp1: GNU OpenMP runtime library, an explicit requirement
# - python3, python3-dev: FIX: Added as a dependency for the LAMMPS cmake build system.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 \
    python3 \
    python3-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set the default working directory for the application runtime
WORKDIR /app

# Clone the latest branch of LAMMPS, build it with the REAXFF package,
# install the executable, copy example files, and clean up source code.
# This is done in a single RUN layer to optimize the final image size.
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /usr/local/src/lammps && \
    mkdir /usr/local/src/lammps/build && \
    cd /usr/local/src/lammps/build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
        -D PKG_REAXFF=on \
        -D BUILD_MPI=yes && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    # Copy the LAMMPS executable to a location on the system PATH
    cp lmp /usr/local/bin/lmp && \
    # Copy the required example files to the final working directory
    cp /usr/local/src/lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/* /app/ && \
    # Clean up the source repository to reduce image size
    rm -rf /usr/local/src/lammps

# Set the final working directory for container execution
WORKDIR /app

flux-minicluster-manifest.item:
#
# MiniCluster Manifest for LAMMPS ReaxFF Test
#
# Environment: AWS CPU instance in Kubernetes
# Application: LAMMPS (ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax)
#
# This manifest defines a Flux MiniCluster to run a small-scale LAMMPS simulation.
# It runs on a single pod (size: 1) and launches 4 MPI tasks within that pod.
#
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reax-test
  # The namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster job.
  # Set to 1 to run all tasks on a single node.
  size: 1

  # Total number of tasks (e.g., MPI ranks) to run for the job.
  # All 4 tasks will be scheduled by Flux within the single pod.
  tasks: 4

  # Ensure job pods are not deleted after completion for debugging purposes.
  cleanup: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Fail on any logging error.
    strict: true

  # Specification for the application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command to be executed by the job.
      # The Flux Operator automatically wraps this with 'flux run'.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      # Per instructions, this container is not explicitly marked as the launcher.
      # The operator will designate the first container in the list as the launcher by default.
      launcher: false

  namespace: default

  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
    launcher: false
  logging:
    strict: true
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: c7a.12xlarge
  size: 1
  tasks: 48

context.details: Ensure all globbed files from examples/reaxff/HNS from the root of the lammps codebase are in the WORKDIR. Clone the latest branch of LAMMPS. You MUST put lmp on the PATH. You MUST install libgomp1.

context.optimize:
You MUST maximize the LAMMPS FOM, k-atom or m-atom steps per second. 
You MUST execute in the pwd with lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite      
You MUST choose instance type and resources that will maximize the FOM.
